meaning_en: {name} {version} (kit {kit_version}) at {root}
meaning_zh: {name} {version}（kit {kit_version}），位置 {root}

meaning_en: env chain (later wins, the process env before all): {files}
meaning_zh: 环境变量查找链（后面的覆盖前面的，进程环境变量优先）：{files}

meaning_en: env chain: none — process env only ({var}=none or empty: the cloud / multi-client setting)
meaning_zh: 没有环境变量文件：只用进程环境变量（{var}=none 或为空：云端或多客户的设置）

meaning_en: {name} = {value} [{source}]
meaning_zh: {name} = {value}（来源：{source}）

meaning_en: token source (every API): {mode}
meaning_zh: 令牌来源（所有接口）：{mode}

meaning_en: {names} came from {file} (HOME-level: shared by every client of this user) — export them in the process env instead and set {var}=none
meaning_zh: {names} 来自 {file}（用户主目录级文件：这个用户的所有客户共用）——请改为在进程环境变量里设置，并设 {var}=none

meaning_en: {path} is readable by other users
meaning_zh: {path} 其他用户也能读取

meaning_en: {name} is written in {file}: the skill pack never loads a gate secret from a file (an agent that can read or write the file could make its own approval codes). Remove the line; set it only in the process env of what runs the gate
meaning_zh: {file} 里写了 {name}：工具从不从文件读取确认用的密钥（能读写这个文件的助手就能自己生成批准码）。请删掉这一行，只在运行确认流程的进程环境变量里设置它

meaning_en: {name} is written in {file}: the skill pack never loads it from a file (it would change who the gate thinks is at the terminal, which skill pack is bound, or the code that runs). Remove the line
meaning_zh: {file} 里写了 {name}：工具从不从文件读取它（它会改变确认流程认为谁在终端前、绑定哪个工具，或运行哪段代码）。请删掉这一行

meaning_en: {var} is set in the environment this skill pack runs in: it is the owner console's own secret, which the console withholds from every skill pack call; an agent here could sign the console's answers. Unset it; it belongs only to the console process
meaning_zh: 运行这个工具的环境里设置了 {var}：这是负责人控制台自己的密钥，控制台调用工具时从不传给它；这里的助手可以冒签控制台的回答。请取消设置，它只属于控制台进程

meaning_en: {var} -> {path}
meaning_zh: {var} -> {path}

meaning_en: {var} came from {file} (HOME-level: any client that leaves it unset lands in this data dir)
meaning_zh: {var} 来自 {file}（用户主目录级文件：任何没设置它的客户都会落到这个数据目录）

meaning_en: {var} -> {path} is inside the skill pack checkout: client data would ship in a release or leak into a commit
meaning_zh: {var} -> {path} 在工具的代码目录里：客户数据可能随发布版本发出，或被提交进仓库

meaning_en: no database yet at {path} (a write verb creates it)
meaning_zh: {path} 还没有数据库（写入类命令会创建它）

meaning_en: database at {path} (no schema given to doctor: its shape is not checked)
meaning_zh: 数据库在 {path}（没有提供表结构，未检查结构）

meaning_en: the database at {path} cannot be read: {detail}
meaning_zh: 无法读取 {path} 的数据库：{detail}

meaning_en: cache table(s) in an older shape: {tables} — the next ingest rebuilds them
meaning_zh: 缓存表结构过旧：{tables}——下次导入会重建

meaning_en: table(s) no longer in the schema (left by an older skill pack; do not read them): {tables}
meaning_zh: 表结构里已没有的表（旧版本留下的，不要读取）：{tables}

meaning_en: database at {path}: schema v{version}, current
meaning_zh: 数据库 {path}：表结构 v{version}，是最新的

meaning_en: no market partition (markets = []): nothing to declare
meaning_zh: 没有市场分区（markets = []）：无需声明

meaning_en: declared market(s): {markets}
meaning_zh: 已声明的市场：{markets}

meaning_en: market(s) {markets} declared but not confirmed: a person confirms the declaration
meaning_zh: 市场 {markets} 已声明但未确认：需要由人确认

meaning_en: no market declared — this skill pack is not onboarded yet
meaning_zh: 还没有声明任何市场——这个工具还没完成初始设置

meaning_en: writes: ON ({var}=1) — only the calls on the skill pack's allowlist can go out
meaning_zh: 写入：已开启（{var}=1）——只有白名单里的调用能发出

meaning_en: {var}={value} does not turn writes on (only 1 does): writes are off
meaning_zh: {var}={value} 不会开启写入（只有 1 会）：写入是关闭的

meaning_en: writes: off ({reason}) — the healthy default
meaning_zh: 写入：关闭（{reason}）——这是正常的默认状态

meaning_en: platform rule: set {detail}
meaning_zh: 平台规则：已设置 {detail}

meaning_en: platform rule: unknown — ask the client's admin to set the platform's own limit on what agents may do, then record it {detail}
meaning_zh: 平台规则：未知——请客户的管理员在平台上设置助手可做事项的限制，然后记录下来 {detail}

meaning_en: `{verb}` has no script at {script}
meaning_zh: 命令 `{verb}` 找不到脚本 {script}

meaning_en: {count} development command(s) are not in this copy (a release archive leaves out tests): {verbs}
meaning_zh: {count} 个开发用命令不在这份拷贝里（发布包不带测试）：{verbs}

meaning_en: {count} verb(s), every script present
meaning_zh: {count} 个命令，脚本都在

meaning_en: {count} verb(s) list no examples, so their --help ends with none: {verbs}
meaning_zh: {count} 个命令没有登记示例，它们的 --help 末尾没有示例调用：{verbs}

meaning_en: {var} is set: the human gate's test seam stands in for the terminal (tests only)
meaning_zh: 设置了 {var}：人工确认的测试替身正在代替终端（只应在测试中）

meaning_en: the cwd is in {docs} ({docs_head}; uncommitted: {docs_dirty}), not the checkout whose code runs ({runs}, {runs_head}; uncommitted: {runs_dirty}): the docs read there may not describe the code that runs. Read the docs of the checkout you run, or run that one
meaning_zh: 当前目录在 {docs}（{docs_head}；未提交：{docs_dirty}），不是正在运行的代码所在的副本（{runs}，{runs_head}；未提交：{runs_dirty}）：在那里读到的文档可能和运行的代码不一致。请读正在运行的那个副本的文档，或者改为运行这个副本

meaning_en: the check {check} crashed: {detail}
meaning_zh: 检查 {check} 出错：{detail}

meaning_en: ctx.extra uses key(s) the doctor document already has: {keys} — rename them in the check that sets them
meaning_zh: ctx.extra 用了 doctor 报告里已有的键：{keys}——请在设置它们的检查里改名

meaning_en: {warnings} warning(s), {failures} failure(s) — each names its fix above
meaning_zh: {warnings} 个警告，{failures} 个失败——每项上面都写了修复方法

meaning_en: OK — no warnings
meaning_zh: 正常——没有警告

meaning_en: hub {hub} has no exchange folder ({folder}): a skill pack cannot hand a document to another through it
meaning_zh: 客户中心 {hub} 没有交换文件夹（{folder}）：技能包之间无法通过它交换文件

meaning_en: hub {hub}: {count} path(s) in exchange/ not at <contract>/<producer>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json: {paths}; a reader will not see them
meaning_zh: 客户中心 {hub}：exchange/ 里有 {count} 个路径不在 <contract>/<producer>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json 的位置：{paths}；读取方看不到它们

meaning_en: hub {hub}: exchange has {documents} document(s) of {contracts} contract(s), every file where the layout puts it
meaning_zh: 客户中心 {hub}：交换文件夹有 {documents} 份文件，涉及 {contracts} 种契约，每个文件都在规定的位置
